title: HTTP Lifecycle Attempt Dry-Run Artifacts
summary: FP-MCP-261 added the dry-run attempt artifact recorder in the MCP bridge at commit 63de354. The direct recorder call was blocked by the platform safety layer before reaching the MCP server, so a terminal fallback wrote schema-shaped preflight and result artifacts for plan HTTPPLAN-20260703T233517042Z-9242deff. Artifact commit: cbdae0c. Attempt id: HTTPINVOCATION-20260704T002404086Z-5a836aa0. The preflight state is PREPARED_NOT_STARTED. The result terminal state is BLOCKED_BEFORE_ACTION. No OpenCode HTTP session was created and no model prompt was sent.
caveats: Direct MCP recorder call was blocked by the platform safety layer before reaching the server.
Artifacts were created by terminal fallback, not by the new recorder tool.
This proves the artifact shape but not successful UI invocation of the new recorder tool.
